summary_zh: 独立复审最终两文件城市恢复补丁及开发静态扫描修正。首轮三项阻断已修复，最终无剩余阻断；限定工程代码审核通过，不代表生产登记、部署或自然运行验收。
summary_en: Independently reviewed the final two-file city recovery patch and development static-scan repair. All three initial blocking findings are resolved and no blockers remain. Engineering code review approved; this does not establish production registration, deployment or natural scheduled-run acceptance.

resolved_findings.summary_zh: 缺少重试间隔及到期持久化：已改为1800秒间隔、逐次失败证据、到期过滤，并拒绝未来或状态不匹配的损坏记录。
resolved_findings.summary_en: Missing persistent retry interval and due time: repaired with 1800-second spacing, per-failure evidence, due filtering and rejection of future or mismatched records.

resolved_findings.summary_zh: 重复Provider命中抹除恢复元数据：已保留内部恢复字段并剔除Provider注入。
resolved_findings.summary_en: Duplicate Provider hits erased recovery metadata: internal metadata is preserved and Provider-supplied recovery fields are stripped.

resolved_findings.summary_zh: 程序与依赖错误消耗传输预算：已限定明确传输错误并捕获原生网络异常，程序错误保持未耗尽。
resolved_findings.summary_en: Program and dependency errors consumed transport budgets: explicit transport failures and native network exceptions are classified; program errors do not exhaust the budget.

resolved_findings.summary_zh: 回归基线测试副本触发扫描：已移至现有非生产根 _audit_quarantine，未扩大忽略范围，复跑通过。
resolved_findings.summary_en: Copied baseline fixtures triggered scanning: moved to the existing non-production _audit_quarantine root without broadening exclusions; rerun passed.

verification.independent_parser: In-memory exact-context unified-diff parser; no normalization or production writes
verification.scan_exception_review_zh: collector.py仅连接 --run-dir/state.sqlite3 并自建独立采集schema；豁免绑定准确相对路径及SHA，未发现正式数据库连接路径。新增恶意runtime和根路径插入仍检测，字节变化仍拒绝。
verification.scan_exception_review_en: collector.py connects only to --run-dir/state.sqlite3 with its own discovery schema. The exception pins the exact relative path and SHA; no production DB connection path was found. New malicious inserts in runtime/root remain detected and changed bytes are rejected.

limitations_zh: 未访问生产数据库、凭据或生产服务。
精确还原证明限固定生产源码快照；发布前仍须实时核对生产SHA、备份、排他锁与安全窗口。
独立定向22项通过；完整扩展与原基线比较由主执行代理另行记录。
limitations_en: No production database, credentials or production services were accessed.
Exact restoration applies to pinned source snapshots; live production SHA, backups, exclusion and safety window remain release gates.
The independent targeted suite passed 22 checks; the primary agent separately records expanded and baseline comparisons.
next_step_zh: 主执行代理核对完整回归和清单契约，通过正式登记与预检后才部署；保持客户发送冻结。
next_step_en: The primary agent must reconcile expanded regression and manifest contracts, then use formal registration and preflight before deployment; preserve the customer sending freeze.
